caption: The drawing depicts a single object, a pitcher with a covered lid, rendered in shades of gray and muted blue. The pitcher is centrally placed within a rectangular frame on a beige or off-white background. The vessel has a bulbous lower body that narrows at the neck and expands slightly at the rim. The base of the pitcher is rounded and slightly flared. An elongated, curved handle is attached to the side, arching from the top of the neck to just above the base, with a decorative thumb piece on the lid mechanism. The lid is flat and circular, fitting snugly over the opening, with a small finial used to lift it. The shading and highlights suggest the pitcher is made of a smooth, reflective material, likely metal. The composition is simple and uncluttered, with the pitcher sharply detailed against the plain background and a thin line border framing the entire presentation.
title: Pewter Coffee Pot
